STEP 6. Check connectors C-27 at intermediate connector 
and C-43 at combination meter for damage. <Vehicles with 
sport mode>
Q: Are the connectors in good condition?
YES : Repair it because of the harness damage between 
the Park/Neutral Position Switch connector B-41 
terminal 3 and combination meter connector C-43 
terminal 11.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
